verdicts.summary: [L] states a different form; neither implies the other.
evidence: [M] requires alpha_t^n C_j^{h_t(b)+v_t+2} E_t^G <= 1, Q_j^cmp <= log(cutoffsize_t)/(16n), and hatBeta_i in [hatBeta_t/2, hatBeta_t] for k_t <= i <= t, with k_t = t-h_t-v_t. In [L], Charge has fields `charge : ticket O (A.params k) M <= pot A M k` (pot = log(monitor k)/(16*M)), which matches the second requirement, and `assured u : width a b k <= u -> u <= middle a b k -> hatBeta u ∈ Icc (hatBeta k/2) (hatBeta k)`. That band only covers [width, middle] = [k-h-v, k-h], not M's [k_t, t]. [L] has no counterpart of the first (Gaussian error) requirement: `tally : Tally ...` (spouse/bill/Shelf/gas conditions) takes its place, and no declaration states alpha^n C^{h+v+2} E^G <= 1 (the same band hypothesis in `covers` and `v_conditioned` also stops at middle). So neither set of conditions implies the other, and this is a difference in formulation rather than a typo.

[M] requires alpha_t^n C_j^{h_t(b)+v_t+2} E_t^G <= 1, Q_j^cmp <= log(cutoff)/(16n), and hatbeta_i in [hatbeta_t/2, hatbeta_t] for k_t<=i<=t. Charge has allot (Allocated: ticket O (A.params k) M <= pot, pot = log(monitor k)/(16*M), matching the second bound only up to a different quantity), tally (Tally: growth/stops/force bounds, no Gaussian-error product E_t^G, alpha_t or C_j exponent), and assured (hatBeta u in Icc (hatBeta k/2) (hatBeta k) for width<=u<=middle, a shorter range than k..t). No declaration states the first bound as printed and the third is on a different range, so neither statement implies the other. Not a typo; the formulations are different.
